summary_en: Annual dividend per share increased from ¥59.67 to ¥74.35 for FY2026 ending December 2026, a raise of ¥14.68 per share, under a new policy targeting a consolidated payout ratio of 65% or DOE of 4%, whichever is higher.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revisions to Full-Year Earnings Forecast (Upward Revision) and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
GMO GlobalSign Holdings announced on October 19, 2026, that it is raising its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026. The annual dividend per share has been increased from ¥59.67 to ¥74.35, representing an increase of ¥14.68 per share. This revision reflects the company's decision to enhance shareholder returns.

The dividend increase is supported by an upward revision to the company's full-year earnings forecast. Net income attributable to parent company shareholders is now projected at ¥1,312 million, up from the previous forecast of ¥1,052 million, a 24.7% increase. This improvement stems from special gains of ¥440.476 million recorded in the third quarter from the sale of GMO Digital Lab Co., Ltd. subsidiary shares on July 1, 2026, as well as from foreign exchange gains and adjustments to temporary impacts related to cloud infrastructure business service terminations and contract modifications.

Effective for the fiscal year ending December 2026, the company has adopted a new dividend policy targeting either a consolidated payout ratio of 65% or a dividend on equity (DOE) of 4%, whichever is higher. This policy framework aims to provide stable and continuous profit distribution to shareholders. The year-end dividend will be ¥74.35 per share, with the company maintaining its commitment to consistent shareholder returns in line with business performance and capital efficiency objectives.
